newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hang Seng Bank shares hit all time high.
newsitem.headline: Hang Seng Bank shares hit all time high.

text.p: Shares of Hang Seng Bank Ltd surged on speculation that the bank might to be a possible acquisition target of mainland Chinese companies, brokers said on Friday.
Hang Seng Bank shares rose HK$8.25 or 8.53 percent to an all-time high of HK$105 in early trade on volume of 2.61 million shares worth HK$268.63 million.

Hang Seng Bank said in a statement issued through the Hong Kong stock exchange it was not aware of any reason for the share price rise and said there were no disclosable negotiations or agreements relating to intended acquisitions or realisations.
"In terms of P/E, it's not too cheap but in terms of the market it looks like it had lagged a bit behind," said Michael Ng, a dealing director, Sassoon Securities.
Hang Seng Bank's parent HSBC Holdings Plc also rose HK$4.00 to HK$230 each.
